blurb: A single warrior-priest of the XVII Legion infiltrates a world decades before open war begins, and around himself gathers the bitter, the desperate and the faithful. A congregation becomes a sect; a sect becomes cells. Then the Word is spoken, and the world discovers that the rebellion has already begun.
lore: A fan-made kill team: an Apostle of the Word Bearers and the cell he has spent years growing inside a loyal world. The Legionary does not lead the fight so much as supervise the harvest, and the mortals around him have no idea that their faith was cultivated rather than discovered. Most of them will die believing they were the point.

source.publisher: Fan-made. Not a published Games Workshop kill team.
source.notes: Original fan-made kill team supplied by the user as a written design brief and transcribed into this pack. Stat lines, weapon profiles, ploys and equipment are the author's invention, not transcribed from any published source. The brief describes an asymmetric mixed elite/horde team: one extremely powerful Word Bearer and eight fragile mortal cultists who supply activation count, mission actions and disposable bodies.

selectionRules: A COVENANT OF THE HIDDEN WORD kill team consists of 9 operatives: 1 WORD BEARER DARK APOSTLE, 2 CULT DEVOTEE operatives, and 6 different operatives selected from the following list: CELL DEMAGOGUE, ICONARCH, FIREBRAND, SABOTEUR, MALEFIC WITCH, TURNCOAT GUNNER, CELL ENFORCER, SLEEPER AGENT, VOX SEDITIONIST. You cannot select the same specialist more than once.
The Dark Apostle has the CHAOS, WORD BEARERS, HERETIC ASTARTES, DARK APOSTLE, LEADER keywords. All other operatives have the CHAOS, WORD BEARERS, CULTIST keywords.

The bundled covenant is one legal nine — Apostle, Iconarch, Firebrand, Cell Enforcer, Sleeper Agent, Turncoat Gunner and Malefic Witch, plus the two Devotees. It is chosen for this engine rather than from the brief: the Cell Demagogue, the Saboteur and the Vox Seditionist are built around Reveal Cell, Pick Up Marker and mission actions, none of which this engine has, so fielding them spends three of the six specialist slots on bodies with no rules. Swapping them for the six specialists whose abilities do resolve took the covenant from 21% to 43% across 60 battles against Legionary, the Blooded, Chaos Cult, Novitiates and Kommandos. Every one of the nine is still available to a hand-written roster.

operatives.name: Word Bearer Dark Apostle
operatives.lore: He has preached this world into position over a decade, and today is simply the sermon's last line. He does not hurry, and he does not need to be present for most of what he has arranged.

abilities.name: HERETIC ASTARTES
abilities.description: During this operative's activation, it can perform either two Shoot actions or two Fight actions. If it performs two Shoot actions, both must use its Bolt Pistol.

abilities.name: MASTER OF THE CONGREGATION
abilities.description: Once per Turning Point, when a friendly CULTIST operative that is part of the Congregation activates, you can use this ability. Add 1 to that operative's APL until the end of its activation. Its APL cannot be increased above 3.

abilities.name: THE WORD MADE FLESH
abilities.description: Whenever this operative contests an objective or mission marker alongside at least one friendly CULTIST operative, treat the combined APL of your friendly operatives contesting that marker as 1 higher. This is not a change to any operative's APL.

operatives.name: Cell Demagogue
operatives.lore: The Apostle's mortal voice, and the only member of the cell who has met him. He believes he is the leader and has been carefully allowed to.

abilities.name: SECOND VOICE
abilities.description: If your Dark Apostle has been incapacitated, this operative can select the Dark Creed during subsequent Strategy phases. If it does, CULTIST operatives are part of the Congregation while visible to and within 6" of this operative, or within 2" of an Active Cult Cell.

abilities.name: INCITE
abilities.description: Select one other friendly CULTIST operative visible to and within 6". That operative can immediately perform a free 2" Dash. It cannot enter enemy control range during that move. This action can only be performed once per Turning Point.

operatives.name: Iconarch
operatives.lore: He carries the sigil that the cell was taught to pray towards, without knowing what it actually marks or who it is signalling.

abilities.name: ICON OF THE EIGHTFOLD PATH
abilities.description: Whenever another friendly CULTIST operative within 2" of this operative fights, it can re-roll one attack die result of 1.

abilities.name: UNDENIABLE FAITH
abilities.description: While this operative is contesting a marker, friendly CULTIST operatives contesting that same marker cannot have their APL negatively modified for determining control.

operatives.name: Firebrand
operatives.lore: A preacher with a torch and a gift for crowds. Where he has spoken, the district burns before the cell arrives.

abilities.name: BURN THE UNBELIEVER
abilities.description: Whenever this operative shoots an enemy operative that is within 2" of an objective marker, a mission marker, or an Active Cult Cell, its Purifying Flame has Severe.

operatives.name: Saboteur
operatives.lore: He has been inside the infrastructure of this hive for years in an entirely legitimate capacity. Every charge is where it is because of a work order.

abilities.name: INFRASTRUCTURE SPECIALIST
abilities.description: Once during each of this operative's activations, it can perform Reveal Cell, Pick Up Marker or a mission action for 1 less AP, to a minimum of 0AP.

operatives.name: Malefic Witch
operatives.lore: The Apostle found her early and shaped what came through her. She thinks the shaping was divine favour, which is close enough to true to be useless to argue with.

abilities.name: MALEFIC WHISPER
abilities.description: Select one visible enemy operative within 6". Until the end of that enemy operative's next activation, the first time it performs a Shoot or Fight action, worsen the Hit characteristic of its selected weapon by 1 for that attack. This cannot worsen a Hit characteristic beyond 5+. This action can only be performed once per Turning Point.

operatives.name: Turncoat Gunner
operatives.lore: Militia, once. He kept the weapon, the training and the uniform, and the uniform is still doing most of the work.

abilities.name: OLD DRILLS DIE HARD
abilities.description: Whenever this operative shoots while it has Cover from terrain, its selected weapon has Accurate 1.

operatives.name: Cell Enforcer
operatives.lore: He keeps the faithful faithful, with the same methods the Arbites use and a considerably shorter approval process.

abilities.name: DISCIPLINE THROUGH FEAR
abilities.description: Friendly CULTIST operatives within 2" of this operative can ignore characteristic changes caused by being injured.

abilities.name: HOLD THE LINE
abilities.description: Once per Turning Point, when an enemy operative ends a Charge action within control range of another friendly CULTIST operative within 2" of this operative, you can move this operative up to 2". It must finish that move within control range of that enemy operative if possible.

operatives.name: Sleeper Agent
operatives.lore: Nobody in the cell knows his role and neither, on most days, does he. The instruction, when it comes, will not feel like an instruction.

abilities.name: EMBEDDED AGENT
abilities.description: After all operatives have been deployed but before the first Turning Point begins, this operative can perform a free move of up to 3". It must finish this move within 2" of a Cult Cell, not within enemy control range, and not within the enemy drop zone.

abilities.name: PERFECTLY ORDINARY CITIZEN
abilities.description: During Turning Point 1, while this operative has a Conceal order, enemy operatives more than 6" from it cannot treat it as having an Engage order as the result of another rule.

operatives.name: Vox Seditionist
operatives.lore: He owns the district's broadcast for as long as it takes, and what he puts out is precisely calibrated to make the response late.

abilities.name: FALSE ORDERS
abilities.description: Select one visible enemy operative within 6". The next time that operative performs a Reposition, Dash or Charge action before the beginning of this operative's next activation, subtract 2" from its move allowance for that action. This cannot reduce its move allowance below 2". This action can only be performed once per Turning Point.

abilities.name: CELL HANDLER
abilities.description: The first time this operative performs Reveal Cell on the Subverted Vox Node, that action costs 0AP.

operatives.name: Cult Devotee (Autogun)
operatives.lore: A believer with a weapon and no training worth the name. He fires from cover, at length, and is mostly there to be counted.

abilities.name: EXPENDABLE
abilities.description: No special abilities. That is intentional.

operatives.name: Cult Devotee (Zealot)
operatives.lore: He has nothing but conviction and a length of metal, and he closes the distance faster than the armed men beside him.

abilities.name: EXPENDABLE
abilities.description: No special abilities. That is intentional.

factionRules.name: The Hidden Congregation
factionRules.description: Before operatives are deployed, place three Cult Cell markers in the killzone: Profane Shrine, Hidden Armoury and Subverted Vox Node. They must be placed in your territory or neutral territory, more than 6" from the enemy drop zone, more than 4" from another Cult Cell marker, and somewhere an operative could legally stand adjacent to them. All cells begin Dormant. REVEAL CELL (1AP): a friendly CULTIST operative within 1" of a Dormant Cult Cell can perform this action; that Cell becomes Active. PURGE CELL (1AP): an enemy operative within 1" of a Cult Cell can perform this action if it is not within control range of a friendly operative; remove that Cult Cell. PROFANE SHRINE: friendly CULTIST operatives within 2" can ignore characteristic changes caused by being injured, and once per Turning Point one such operative can re-roll one defence die result of 1. HIDDEN ARMOURY: once per Turning Point, a friendly CULTIST operative within 2" that performs a Shoot action has Balanced for that attack. SUBVERTED VOX NODE: once per Turning Point, when a friendly CULTIST operative within 2" activates, you can change its order. IN THIS SIMULATION: Cult Cell markers are placed by the player before deployment and this engine has no custom marker to place, so the killzone's own objective markers stand in for them: a Cell is treated as Active at every marker from the first turning point. That is the cult embedding itself in the ground worth holding, which is where the printed team wants its Cells anyway, but it means Reveal Cell and Purge Cell never happen and the opponent cannot dig a Cell out.

factionRules.name: The Dark Creed
factionRules.description: At the start of each Strategy phase, if your DARK APOSTLE is alive, select one Dark Creed. It lasts until the end of the Turning Point. A CULTIST operative is part of the Congregation while it is visible to and within 6" of your Dark Apostle, or within 2" of an Active Cult Cell. CREED OF HATRED: whenever a CULTIST operative in the Congregation performs its first Fight action during an activation in which it Charged, its selected melee weapon has Balanced. CREED OF MARTYRDOM: CULTIST operatives in the Congregation ignore characteristic changes caused by being injured, and are treated as having +1 APL when determining control of markers. CREED OF INSURRECTION: add 1" to the move allowance of CULTIST operatives in the Congregation whenever they perform Reposition, Dash or Charge.

ruleHooks.notes: the requirement that both Shoot actions use the Bolt pistol is not enforced
printed as fired when the CULTIST activates and chosen freely; here the Apostle hands the point over during its own activation, to the readiest cultist nearest the enemy
printed as a re-roll of ONE attack die result of 1; Ceaseless re-rolls every 1, which is the closest rule in the dice layer and is worth slightly more on a 4-dice profile
measured from the Firebrand rather than from its target, and Cult Cells are not placed, so only objective markers qualify
"while it has Cover from terrain" is not known before the target is chosen, so a Conceal order — the posture a gunner in cover holds — stands in for it
printed as holding only during Turning Point 1; here it holds all battle, and it is written as the ordinary cannot-be-selected clause rather than as a ban on being treated as Engaged

controlModifiers.text: Whenever the Dark Apostle contests a marker alongside at least one friendly CULTIST operative, treat the combined APL of your operatives contesting that marker as 1 higher.

strategicPloys.name: CREED OF HATRED
strategicPloys.description: THE FALSE EMPEROR HAS FAILED YOU. Whenever a CULTIST operative in the Congregation performs its first Fight action during an activation in which it Charged, its selected melee weapon has Balanced.

hooks.notes: the Dark Creed is free and exclusive on the tabletop — one of three, chosen each Strategy phase; here each Creed is a strategic ploy that costs a CP, which is the engine's only Strategy-phase choice. Congregation is the 6" leash on the Apostle without the line-of-sight test, since Cult Cells are not placed.

strategicPloys.name: CREED OF MARTYRDOM
strategicPloys.description: SUFFERING IS TESTIMONY. CULTIST operatives in the Congregation ignore characteristic changes caused by being injured, and are treated as having +1 APL when determining control of markers. This does not modify their actual APL characteristic.

hooks.notes: the Dark Creed is free and exclusive on the tabletop — one of three, chosen each Strategy phase; here each Creed is a strategic ploy that costs a CP, which is the engine's only Strategy-phase choice.

"treated as having +1 APL when determining control of markers" is carried as a token the cultist picks up when it activates inside the Congregation, because control is recomputed continuously and a ploy's hooks only fire at an operative's own activation — so a cultist that has not yet activated this turning point does not have it yet

strategicPloys.name: CREED OF INSURRECTION
strategicPloys.description: THE HOUR HAS COME. Add 1" to the move allowance of CULTIST operatives in the Congregation whenever they perform Reposition, Dash or Charge. This cannot increase a Dash above 4".

hooks.notes: the Dash cap is not applied. See the note on CREED OF HATRED for how the Creeds are paid for.

strategicPloys.name: FANATIC ZEALOTRY
strategicPloys.description: Until the end of the Turning Point, whenever a friendly CULTIST operative that is part of the Congregation fights, its melee weapon has Severe. If its weapon already has Severe, it can instead re-roll one attack die result of 1.

strategicPloys.name: HIDDEN AMONG THE FAITHFUL
strategicPloys.description: Until the end of the Turning Point, whenever an enemy operative shoots a friendly CULTIST operative that has a Conceal order and is within 2" of a Cult Cell, after rolling defence dice you can retain one failed defence die as a normal success. You cannot use this against weapons with Saturate.

hooks.notes: Cult Cells are not placed, so the killzone's objective markers stand in for them; the Saturate exclusion is not applied, and the retained die is carried as a re-roll

strategicPloys.name: THE WORD SPREADS
strategicPloys.description: Until the end of the Turning Point, the first time a friendly CULTIST operative that is part of the Congregation performs Reveal Cell, Pick Up Marker or a mission action, reduce that action's AP cost by 1, to a minimum of 0AP. This ploy can only reduce one action's cost during the Turning Point.
strategicPloys.notes: Not wired up: this engine has no Reveal Cell, Pick Up Marker or mission action to discount.

strategicPloys.name: SERMON WITHOUT END
strategicPloys.description: Until the end of the Turning Point, increase the Dark Apostle's Congregation range from 6" to 9", and the range around Active Cult Cells from 2" to 3". This does not increase the Cells' individual special-effect ranges. Only the Dark Creed is extended.
strategicPloys.notes: Not wired up: the Congregation leash is written into each Creed's own condition, and a ploy cannot reach in and widen another ploy's condition.

firefightPloys.name: A LIFE FOR THE WORD
firefightPloys.description: Use when your Dark Apostle is selected as the target of a Shoot action, before attack dice are rolled. Select a friendly CULTIST operative within 2" of the Dark Apostle. If that Cultist would be a valid target for the attack, it becomes the target instead. The cultist does not have to volunteer.
firefightPloys.notes: Not wired up: the engine has no way to move a declared attack onto a different target once it has been selected.

firefightPloys.name: MARTYR'S EXAMPLE
firefightPloys.description: Use immediately after a friendly CULTIST operative is incapacitated. Select another friendly CULTIST operative visible to and within 6" of the incapacitated operative. It can immediately perform a free 3" Dash. It cannot enter enemy control range during this move. If the incapacitated operative was part of the Congregation, the selected operative can also ignore characteristic changes caused by being injured until the end of its next activation.
firefightPloys.notes: Not wired up: a demise ploy's effects reach the operative that went down, and everything this one does happens to somebody else.

firefightPloys.name: DAEMONIC INVESTITURE
firefightPloys.description: Use during a friendly CULTIST operative's activation, before or after it performs an action. Until the end of that activation: add 1 to its APL, to a maximum of 3; add 1 to the Atk characteristic of its melee weapons; its melee weapons have Severe. At the end of its activation, that operative suffers D3+1 damage. This damage cannot be ignored. This ploy cannot be used on the Malefic Witch.

hooks.notes: the D3+1 the mortal pays at the end of its activation is not inflicted, so the ploy is limited to once per turning point to stand in for the price; the ban on using it on the Malefic Witch is not enforced

firefightPloys.name: IT WAS ALWAYS A TRAP
firefightPloys.description: Use when an enemy operative ends a Reposition, Dash or Charge action within 1" of one of your Cult Cell markers. Remove that Cell marker from the killzone. That enemy operative suffers D3 mortal wounds. A Cell removed this way counts as Purged.
firefightPloys.notes: Not wired up: Cult Cell markers are not placed, and the engine has no interrupt that fires on an enemy operative finishing a move.

equipment.name: HEXED AMMUNITION
equipment.description: Once per Turning Point, when a friendly CULTIST operative performs a Shoot action, before rolling attack dice you can use this equipment. Its selected ranged weapon has Piercing Crits 1 during that attack.

equipment.name: REINFORCED SAFEHOUSES
equipment.description: The first time during the battle an enemy operative successfully performs Purge Cell, do not remove that Cell. Instead, return it to Dormant. The next Purge Cell action against it removes it normally.

equipment.name: PROFANE RELIQUARIES
equipment.description: Increase the special-effect radius of your Profane Shrine from 2" to 3". Its Congregation range remains unchanged unless affected by another rule.

equipment.name: CONCEALED WEAPON CACHES
equipment.description: Once per Turning Point, when a CULTIST operative within 2" of your Hidden Armoury is selected as the target of a Shoot action, after rolling defence dice you can retain one failed defence die as a normal success.
